title: Clear agent-chats and export all sessions

messages.content:
You are a subagent spawned by another session.
You are working in the project at /Users/giovannacoi/Documents/ARENA course/solar-power (that is already your working directory). Do these two tasks in order, then report back.

TASK 1 — Clear the agent-chats folder (but KEEP the folder itself):
Delete every file inside `agent-chats/`, but do not delete the `agent-chats/` directory. Currently it contains only JSON files. A safe command is:
    find agent-chats -mindepth 1 -type f -delete
(If you prefer, `rm -f agent-chats/*.json` also works.) Verify the folder is empty afterwards with `ls -la agent-chats/`.

TASK 2 — Export every session in this project to JSON:
Run:
    uv run python scripts/export_all_chats.py
This script reads the local OpenCode database and writes ONE JSON file per session into `agent-chats/` (that is the default output directory). It records all message types, includes sub-agent sessions (flagged with a `-subagent` filename suffix), and captures assistant "thinking".

IMPORTANT: Do NOT pass any extra flags, and do NOT pass an output directory argument — use the default `agent-chats/` output. Expect around 16-17 session files to be written.

REPORT BACK (concise):
1. Confirm the folder was emptied (and how many files were deleted).
2. Paste the script's final summary line (the "N created, M overwritten (X sessions, project ...)" line).
3. Run `ls agent-chats/` and paste the list of resulting filenames.
4. Note anything unexpected (errors, warnings, odd filenames).
